sql.if: and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = r.role_id and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and (r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and c.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_role_dept where role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and c.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and c.owner_id=#{currentUserId})) )

mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_contract c where c.contract_id=#{contractId} and c.del_flag='0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = r.role_id and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and ( r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and c.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_role_dept where role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and c.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and c.owner_id=#{currentUserId}) ) )

select 'total' metricKey,count(*) metricValue from biz_contract c where del_flag='0' union all select 'monthNew',count(*) from biz_contract c where del_flag='0' and date_format(create_time,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') union all select 'pendingAudit',count(*) from biz_contract c where del_flag='0' and audit_status='1' union all select 'performing',count(*) from biz_contract c where del_flag='0' and contract_status='1' union all select 'monthAmount',coalesce(sum(sign_amount),0) from biz_contract c where del_flag='0' and date_format(sign_date,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m')
select case_type itemName,count(*) itemValue from biz_contract c where del_flag='0' group by case_type

select rule_id ruleId,rule_name ruleName,prefix,date_pattern datePattern,serial_length serialLength,current_serial currentSerial,status,remark from biz_contract_no_rule order by rule_id

select template_id templateId,template_name templateName,status from biz_contract_template where template_id=#{templateId}
